usdRate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, official exchange rate (PA.NUS.FCRF), Eswatini
usdRate.note: 2025 average. The lilangeni is pegged one to one to the South African rand, which also circulates as legal tender.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Central Bank of Eswatini, Monetary Policy Statement of 25 September 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Headline consumer inflation 2.8% year on year in August 2026 (2.5% in July); Central Statistical Office data reported by the central bank, whose site showed 2.9% for September 2026.

inflation_projection.sourceName: Central Bank of Eswatini forecasts (3.86% for 2027, 3.45% for 2028); IMF WEO average 2021-2025 about 4.1%
inflation_projection.note: The lilangeni is pegged one to one to the South African rand, so inflation tracks South Africa's; the central bank's medium-term forecasts of 3.5-3.9% and the 5-year average of about 4.1% round to 4%.

policy_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Eswatini, Monetary Policy Statement of 25 September 2026 (discount rate)
policy_rate.note: Discount rate raised by 25 basis points to 7.00% effective 26 September 2026; banks' prime lending rate moved to 10.50%.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Eswatini, Quarterly Review June 2026, Table 3 (savings deposit rates for banks and building society)
savings_account_rate.note: Ordinary savings balances earned about 2.2-4.0% at end June 2026 depending on the bank and balance (higher balances up to about 6%); 3% is the typical rate.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Eswatini, Quarterly Review June 2026, Table 2 (comparative interest rates, 88-day deposits)
fdr_3m_rate.note: 88-day term deposit rates at end June 2026 ranged from about 1.1% to 3.35% across banks (6-month rates 3.2-6.45%); 3% is the typical rate.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Eswatini, Recent Economic Developments August/September 2026 (economic indicators: deposit rate 12 months)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Average 12-month deposit rate 5.03% in August 2026, unchanged since February 2026; the 31-day rate averaged 2.31%.

dps_rate.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product or published rate was found in the central bank's interest rate tables.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, deposit interest rate (FR.INR.DPST), Eswatini
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 3.90% average for 2024 (older than 2025); the central bank's August 2026 averages were 2.31% for 31 days and 5.03% for 12 months.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found; individuals can buy ordinary government bonds through primary dealers (minimum E10,000).

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Eswatini, Recent Economic Developments August/September 2026 (economic indicators: T. bill rate)
tbill_91d_rate.note: Treasury bill rate 7.93% in August 2026 (7.88-7.98% since February); the central bank does not split it by tenor in this table. The June 2026 Quarterly Review gives an average yield of 8.35%.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Eswatini, Government Bonds advert October 2026 (SG145, maturing 31 March 2031)
tbond_5y_rate.note: Fixed coupon of the 5-year benchmark bond SG145 reopened at the 28 October 2026 auction; this is the coupon, not the auction yield, and recent issues sold at a premium (yield below coupon).

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Eswatini, Government Bonds advert October 2026 (SG147, maturing 31 March 2036)
tbond_10y_rate.note: Fixed coupon of the 10-year benchmark bond SG147 reopened at the 28 October 2026 auction; this is the coupon, not the auction yield, and recent issues sold at a premium (yield below coupon).

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: Eswatini Revenue Service, Rates and Thresholds (withholding tax on interest paid to residents)
tax_bank_interest.note: Withholding tax of 10% on interest paid to residents (page read 31 October 2026).

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate for individuals exists; the tax treatment of government bond interest for individuals was not confirmed separately from the 10% withholding on interest.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: The deposit insurance cover per depositor could not be confirmed; the deposit insurance fund's website was not reachable and the central bank reports read do not state it.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or typical credit card rate was found; banks' prime lending rate was 10.50% from September 2026 (Central Bank of Eswatini).

equity_return_low.sourceName: Central Bank of Eswatini: very small local stock exchange; retail unit trusts invest mostly in South African and global markets; lilangeni pegged to the rand
equity_return_low.note: Low case: a weak decade for South African and global equities in rand terms.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Central Bank of Eswatini: very small local stock exchange; retail unit trusts invest mostly in South African and global markets; lilangeni pegged to the rand
equity_return_base.note: The local exchange is too small to guide, so equity means rand-based unit trusts tracking South African and global shares; held at about 4 points above the after-tax 1-year deposit rate (about 4.5%).

equity_return_high.sourceName: Central Bank of Eswatini: very small local stock exchange; retail unit trusts invest mostly in South African and global markets; lilangeni pegged to the rand
equity_return_high.note: High case: South African and global equities repeat their long-run record in rand terms.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Lilangeni pegged to the South African rand; dollar gold trend plus long-run rand depreciation
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold with a slightly firmer rand.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Lilangeni pegged to the South African rand; dollar gold trend plus long-run rand depreciation
gold_return_base.note: Base case: about 4% dollar gold trend plus 2-3% a year of rand depreciation against the dollar.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Lilangeni pegged to the South African rand; dollar gold trend plus long-run rand depreciation
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong gold years with a weaker rand.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Central Bank of Eswatini deposit and treasury bill rates (August 2026); 10% withholding on interest (Eswatini Revenue Service)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: savings accounts and short deposits around 3%, less 10% withholding.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Central Bank of Eswatini deposit and treasury bill rates (August 2026); 10% withholding on interest (Eswatini Revenue Service)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of 12-month deposits (5.03%, 4.5% after tax) and treasury bills or bonds (7.9-10%), net of tax.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Central Bank of Eswatini deposit and treasury bill rates (August 2026); 10% withholding on interest (Eswatini Revenue Service)
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: mostly government bonds bought through primary dealers (coupons 10-11%), net of tax and price risk.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life claim settlement ratio was found from the Financial Services Regulatory Authority.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published indicative term life premium rates per E1,000 of cover were found from the regulator or a public source.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private medical aid premiums by age were found from a public source.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Eswatini
oop_health_share.note: 11.0% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database via the World Bank), the latest available; older than 2025.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Central Bank of Eswatini Annual Economic Review 2025/26 (CPI by COICOP category); planning inflation 4%
goal_inflation_health.note: No separate health price series was readable; private medical costs and medical aid contributions in the region rise about 2 points above headline inflation, so 6% is used.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Central Bank of Eswatini Annual Economic Review 2025/26 (CPI by COICOP category); planning inflation 4%
goal_inflation_education.note: No separate education price series was readable; school and tertiary fees in the region rise about 2 points above headline inflation, so 6% is used.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), Eswatini

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (the page gives a both-sexes figure only at 65).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 6.94 (2025, World Bank), 8.0 (2040, populationpyramid.net/swaziland/2040/) and 16.5 (2065, populationpyramid.net/swaziland/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Eswatini National Provident Fund (ENPF), age benefit
retirement_age_default.note: Private-sector workers belong to the ENPF, a provident fund that pays a lump-sum age benefit from 50 (or from 45 on retirement from regular employment); there is no statutory lifetime pension age for the private sector. Same for men and women.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: Public Service Pensions Fund (PSPF), retirement benefits
retirement_age_government.note: Compulsory retirement at 60 for civil servants (judges at 75); early retirement from 45 with at least 10 years of service.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Central Bank of Eswatini: 12-month deposit rate 5.03% and treasury bill rate 7.93% (August 2026); 10% withholding on interest
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: savings and short deposits after 10% withholding.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Central Bank of Eswatini: 12-month deposit rate 5.03% and treasury bill rate 7.93% (August 2026); 10% withholding on interest
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: equal to the 12-month deposit rate after 10% withholding (5.03% x 0.9), below the after-tax treasury bill rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Central Bank of Eswatini: 12-month deposit rate 5.03% and treasury bill rate 7.93% (August 2026); 10% withholding on interest
retirement_return_high.note: High case: more in treasury bills and government bonds, after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Safe rate about 5%; rand-based equity base 9%; gold base 6.5%
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: mostly deposits and bills.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Safe rate about 5%; rand-based equity base 9%; gold base 6.5%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of government bonds, deposits and rand-based equity unit trusts.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Safe rate about 5%; rand-based equity base 9%; gold base 6.5%
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case: a growth-leaning mix with more equity.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: The amount of the non-contributory Old Age Grant could not be confirmed from an official source; the government portal (gov.sz) was not reachable and the central bank reports read do not state it.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: The eligibility rules of the non-contributory Old Age Grant could not be confirmed from an official source; the government portal (gov.sz) was not reachable.

gratuity_rule.note: The Employment Act provisions on severance or end-of-service pay could not be read from an official source.

public_pension_scheme.note: No public lifetime pension for private-sector workers was confirmed: the Eswatini National Provident Fund pays a lump-sum age benefit from 50 (enpf.co.sz/age-benefits/), and PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries (reviewed 30 March 2026) says there are no social security contributions. Civil servants have a defined-benefit pension (PSPF, 2% of final salary per year of service from 60).

savings_account.note: Rates of about 2-4% on ordinary balances at end June 2026 (Central Bank of Eswatini).

fdr_3m.note: Short fixed deposits are offered; 88-day rates were about 1-3.35% at end June 2026.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product was found in the central bank's rate tables.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: Treasury bills are auctioned by the central bank; holders include individuals and other investors (Quarterly Review June 2026).

tbond_5y.note: Bond auctions are open to individuals through primary dealers, minimum E10,000 for non-competitive bids.

tbond_10y.note: 10-year benchmark bonds are reopened at regular auctions open to individuals.

equity_fund.note: Collective investment schemes are licensed by the Financial Services Regulatory Authority; most invest in South African and global markets.

gold.note: Gold jewellery and coins can be bought; no official local bullion scheme was found.

pensionScheme.name: Eswatini National Provident Fund (ENPF)
pensionScheme.note: A lump-sum provident fund for private-sector workers; civil servants belong to the Public Service Pensions Fund (pspf.co.sz).
